name: vanilla
description: A framework-free browser frontend — standard DOM API + ES modules. For landing pages, widgets, and lightweight sites. The bundler defaults to Vite.

notes.serverCode: No server runtime — the backend axis owns server logic entirely. If the backend is a BaaS, the browser calls the SDK directly, so the data-layer policy is the only boundary
notes.language: The default is JavaScript. Pick TypeScript and the type-standard slot becomes active; with JavaScript that slot is replaced by JSDoc comment conventions
notes.guideShape: Fill the component and state-management slots with DOM manipulation boundaries, module patterns, and event delegation rather than framework idioms. Routing is the History API or multiple HTML entry points
